description: Apply identical firewall rule to staging (safe — same as existing prod rule)

playbook.content:
- name: Mirror prod firewall rule on staging
  hosts: staging
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        protocol: tcp
        destination_port: 443
        jump: ACCEPT

tier_rationale: Staging only, mirroring a known-safe prod rule
